summary.headline: GREEN PLUS Co. amends rights offering: KRW 12bn third-party allotment of redeemable convertible preferred shares
summary.what_happened: GREEN PLUS Co., Ltd. filed a corrected major-matters report on its third-party allotment rights offering, originally filed on Dec 16, 2021. The amendment extends the redemption period to Dec 22, 2027 and the conversion period end date to Dec 23, 2027, and changes the stated term of the new shares from 5 years to 6 years.
summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, rights offerings and convertible preferred share issues dilute existing common shareholders when converted and can carry redemption or conversion rights that affect the company's future share count and cash obligations. Corrections to such filings typically change the terms investors rely on, so shareholders often review the amended dates and conditions.
